# MM Axion Solutions

MM Axion Solutions is a software house. They design applications, secure systems, run SEO, and maintain services. One partner from the first idea through long-term care.

Languages: Polish and English.

Contact: m.malagocki@mmaxionsolutions.com, +48 515 254 838

Own products:
- Boxly, warehouse software: https://www.boxly.tech/
- UNIPost, courier platform: https://unipost.tech/app

Practices: application design, development and fixes, system security, SEO and visibility, service maintenance, IT consulting.

Also: AI and large language models, generative graphics, 3D models and visualizations, adoption and education.

How they work: Discovery, Design and plan, Build, Launch and care.

Selected work: Remonty Progres, a renovation company in Łódź. Website, SEO, branding.

Clients named on the site: Remonty Progres, Goldenberry, Szot i Wspólnicy, Kedar, Krajowe Centrum Odszkodowań i Rekompensat, EPF, Doradztwo Księgowe, Brandwagon.

Polish name for the same company: MM Axion Solutions. Strona po polsku opisuje te same usługi, produkty Boxly i UNIPost, oraz ten sam kontakt.
